mechanism: Both agents have sympathomimetic and CNS effects; amantadine is a dopamine agonist and NMDA antagonist while brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist, potentially resulting in additive CNS stimulation and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for increased CNS side effects (dizziness, insomnia, nervousness) and blood pressure changes; counseling on appropriate ophthalmic instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption is recommended.
